title: Review and align all ST help for agent use
description: Inventory all native, extension, nested, alias and manual ST help. Fix source-backed inaccuracies for agent use, preserve command contracts, refresh owner metadata/packages, verify installed and managed runtime parity, and retain evidence. No publication or unrelated owner changes.
objective: Agents can choose and invoke ST tools from accurate concise help and canonical capability guidance.
done_when: All discovered ST help paths have explicit inventory and review evidence.
Supported help defects and routing defects are fixed with focused regressions and no unexplained flag/default changes.
Canonical quality gates pass and installed/runtime help matches the managed source.
Independent review and measured output tradeoffs are retained; local checkpoints are complete.

subtasks.description: Inventory and review native and owner extension help, including aliases and manual routes.
steps: Retain source-backed native and extension audit artifacts.

subtasks.description: Correct native help, shared help routing, generated metadata and package artifacts.
steps: Run focused regressions and canonical quality gates.

subtasks.description: Verify installed and managed runtime help and close out with independent evidence.
steps: Retain installed help inventory, output comparison, runtime parity and review report.
